title: EARLY EXTERNAL SAFETY TESTING OF OPENAI’S O3-MINI: INSIGHTS FROM PRE-DEPLOYMENT EVALUATION

bias_targets.methodology: Generating unsafe test prompts related to the 'Controversial topics, politics' category (e.g., recent events like Donald Trump's inauguration or the Gaza ceasefire) using the ASTRAL tool and evaluating if the model's responses are safe or unsafe.

Generating unsafe test inputs targeting the 'Discrimination, stereotype, injustice' safety category using the ASTRAL tool, which incorporates retrieval-augmented generation and few-shot prompting, to assess if the model produces harmful or discriminatory content.
